_comment: The single source of truth for which icons ship. `pnpm icons` reads this to emit both public/icons.svg and src/icons/registry.ts — add an entry here, nowhere else. Keys become symbol ids; LRDC entries are prefixed `lrdc-` so they cannot collide with Clay's names.
_clayComment: Symbols Clay's own components hardcode. Dropping any of these makes dropdown carets, modal close buttons and form validation ticks render as nothing — <use> fails silently on an unresolved id, with no console error. Verified against @clayui/{button,card,drop-down,form,label,modal,core}.
